content.stem: 巴塞尔银行监管委员会(BCBS)是一个由各国中央银行和银行业监管机构的高级代表组成的国际机构.以下哪项陈述准确描述了巴塞尔委员会提供的指导？(选择三项.)

options.A: 由于巴塞尔委员会没有执法权,它依靠其成员的承诺来执行其指导方针.
options.B: 巴塞尔指导方针包括应纳入当地法律框架的标准、实施指南以及最佳实践指导.
options.C: 巴塞尔委员会的核心原则包括有关客户身份识别和客户接纳政策的指导方针
options.D: 巴塞尔银行监管委员会的成员必须执行其标准,否则将面临被暂停成员资格的处罚.
options.E: 巴塞尔委员会由全球28家最大的银行组成

content.stem_en: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) is an international body consisting of senior representatives of central banks and banking regulatory authorities. Which of the following statements accurately describe guidance provided by the BCBS? (Select three.)

options_en.A: Since the Basel Committee has no enforcement authority, it relies on the commitment of its members to carry out its guidance.
options_en.B: Basel guidance includes standards to be incorporated into local legal frameworks, guidelines for implementation, and best-practice guidance.
options_en.C: The Basel Committee's Core Principles include guidance on customer identification and acceptance.
options_en.D: Members of the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision must implement its standards or face suspension of membership.
options_en.E: The Basel Committee consists of the 28 largest banks in the world.
